decisions.decision: Treat the five XRPL source wallets as Binance PoR-labelled according to Bitquery, but do not claim verified customer-liability coverage.
decisions.reason: Bitquery says all 17 drained hot wallets carry Binance PoR labels; the raw official export and same-time XRP liabilities have not been independently re-parsed.

decisions.decision: Keep Ethereum and XRPL receiver clusters separate; represent only common incident context at event level.
decisions.reason: Bitquery explicitly reports the XRP receiver shares no address with the rest of the attack.

decisions.decision: Keep individual ETH transfers, stash balances and aggregate ETH loss as separate measurements until reconciled.
decisions.reason: CoinDesk and Bitquery values differ by 2,000 ETH to 9,030.4 ETH depending on measurement scope.

decisions.decision: Do not use the October 30 06:43 receiver balance as a current October 31 state.
decisions.reason: It is a historical snapshot; fresh XRPL account_info has not been executed.
